description: This file defines a DiagnosisValidator class that implements validation logic for Diagnosis objects within the OpenMRS project. The class ensures that necessary fields such as encounter, diagnosis, certainty, and rank are present and meet specific criteria. It supports diagnosing validation, especially for non-voided diagnoses.

classes.name: DiagnosisValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the Diagnosis object that implements the Spring Validator interface, validating fields such as encounter, diagnosis, certainty, and rank.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class being validated is a Diagnosis class or a subclass.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Diagnosis object, ensuring required fields are present and meet validation rules. Throws APIException if the Diagnosis object is null.
